title: $1,000 in Apple in 2003 is now worth this
caption:
In 2003, Apple was selling iPods.
$1,000 in it then would be worth about {growth:AAPL:2003-01-02} today (price growth only, no dividends).
comment: What would you have done with Apple in 2003? 👇
sources: Apple price history, Yahoo Finance (split-adjusted), at render time

scenes.say: Say you put in one thousand dollars.
Watch what it turns into. Today, it would be worth about {growth:AAPL:2003-01-02}.
Time in the market does the heavy lifting.
